verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Brex publishes its own MCP server so external AI assistants can call Brex's tools (brex-docs-21, brex-probe-3) — this is the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether Brex itself can plug in and consume external MCP servers as a client. No evidence exists of Brex acting as an MCP client or letting users attach third-party MCP servers for it to use.
